headline: TEX @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 3.67 at TOR 4.62, with a projected total of 8.29. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TOR: TEX moved -0.27 runs while TOR moved +0.61, changing the projected margin by -0.89 runs. The projected total climbed +0.34, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -6.8%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Cal Quantrill has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Wyatt Langford, Brandon Nimmo, Jake Burger, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jesús Sánchez, Josh Jung because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
